Defined in: website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/render.tsx:84

One slide's inner content — a with the item's CDN src (folder + src), intrinsic size for aspect-ratio layout, and the expand/video/label flags. For mixed carousels on mobile, landscape slides include a mirrored repetition pattern backdrop to compensate for height. Returns null for placeholder entries.

Parameters

item

CarouselItem | null

Slide descriptor, or null for empty slots.

folder

string

CDN folder prefix (e.g. 'projectslug/').

isMixed?

boolean = false

Whether the carousel contains both landscape and portrait items.

| Element | null
